text: This report presents a Grants Policy for Board adoption. The Policy is in compliance with the requirements articulated in Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s updated Relationship Framework with the City and outlines Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s key grant making requirements and accountabilities.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Adopted the Grants Policy as presented in Attachment 1 to the report (April 13, 2023) from the Senior Grants Manager, Toronto Atmospheric Fund, with the second paragraph in the Collaborative Funding – Low Carbon Cities Canada section on Page 6, amended to read as follows: "To ensure robust governance and enable timely decision-making, TAF participation in an LC3 collaborative grant must adhere to the following requirements: The grant funding must be drawn from a dedicated allocation towards LC3 collaborative grants which shall form part of the Board-approved annual grants budget; If funding from the dedicated LC3 allocation has not been fully utilized by the final Grants Committee meeting of the year, the remaining balance may be reallocated by the CEO to the annual grants budget as needed; and All LC3 collaborative grants…
